text: Jimmy Kimmel mocks Trump's "I wasn't on the ballot" claim after midterms. "Jimmy" is trending because of Jimmy Kimmel's monologue on his late-night show after the 2026 midterm elections, when he criticized President Donald Trump's claim that he was not on the ballot. The remarks aired on a Wednesday night after more results came in.. Democrats won significant races across the country in the 2026 midterm elections, and Republicans lost several contests. After the results came in, President Trump posted that he was not on the ballot and would have won in a landslide if he had been. Jimmy Kimmel, host of Jimmy Kimmel Live!, responded on his show and told the president to shut up. Seth Meyers on NBC's Late Night and Jimmy Fallon on The Tonight Show also joked about the results. Kimmel and Meyers both pointed out that Trump had campaigned heavily and endorsed many candidates who lost.

What does mutual option declined by player mean? Rays and Cedric Mullins, Oct. 3. A mutual option declined by a player means the player chose not to accept a contract option that both the player and the team had to agree to. If one side says no, the option is void and the player becomes a free agent. On Oct. 30, 2026, Nick Martinez declined his side of a $20 million mutual option with the Tampa Bay Rays.. The Rays declined mutual options on Cedric Mullins and Nick Martinez on Oct. 30, 2026, making both free agents. Such options are rarely accepted by both sides, so the decisions were widely expected.. A mutual option is a contract clause giving both the player and the club the right to keep the deal for another season at a set price. It takes both sides to say yes. Here, the clause only mattered if both agreed, so one refusal ended it. On Friday, Oct. 30, 2026, the Rays declined their $10 million mutual option on outfielder Cedric Mullins for 2027. The 32-year-old will receive a $500,000 buyout instead. The Rays also declined their side of Martinez's option. MLB Network insider Jon Heyman reported Friday morning that Martinez had declined first. The Rays could have chosen to decline the option either way, so the $20 million was never guaranteed. Both players are now free agents. Martinez made $9 million in 2026 and his $4 million buyout brings his total to $13 million for his one season in Tampa Bay. Mullins joined the Rays on a one-year deal last offseason with a total guarantee of $7.5 million, made up of a $7 million salary and a $500,000 buyout. Heyman wrote that basically zero mutual options are exercised by both sides, and it has been over a decade since one was triggered by both teams and players.
